meta.name: azure-enterprise-infra-planner
meta.description: Architect and provision enterprise Azure infrastructure from workload descriptions. For cloud architects and platform engineers planning networking, identity, security, compliance, and multi-resource topologies with WAF alignment. Generates Bicep or Terraform directly (no azd). WHEN: 'plan Azure infrastructure', 'architect Azure landing zone', 'design hub-spoke network', 'plan multi-region DR topology', 'set up VNets firewalls and private endpoints', 'subscription-scope Bicep deployment', 'Azure Backup for VM workloads'. PREFER azure-prepare FOR app-centric workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据工作负载描述自动设计并生成Azure基础设施代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是云架构师或平台工程师，需要快速规划并部署企业级Azure基础设施
copy.tagline_en: Automatically design and provision Azure infrastructure from workload descriptions

howto.what: 根据工作负载描述规划企业级Azure基础设施（网络、身份、安全、合规等），并直接生成Bicep或Terraform代码，覆盖订阅级或多资源组部署，遵循WAF。
howto.when: 当用户提到“规划Azure基础设施”、“设计hub-spoke网络”、“规划多区域灾备拓扑”等表述，或要求生成订阅级Bicep部署时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一个hub-spoke网络架构，生成Bicep代码。
say.note: 会输出网络规划和IaC代码。

say.text: 为这个工作负载设计Azure登录区，用Terraform实现。
say.note: 会生成登录区拓扑与Terraform文件。

say.text: 规划多区域灾备拓扑，包含VNet和防火墙。
say.note: 会给出跨区域高可用方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude plans enterprise-scale Azure infrastructure (networking, identity, security, compliance, etc.) from workload descriptions and directly generates Bicep or Terraform code for subscription-scope or multi-resource-group deployments, aligned with WAF.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions phrases like "plan Azure infrastructure", "design hub-spoke network", "plan multi-region DR topology", or asks for subscription-scope Bicep deployments.

say_en.text: Plan a hub-spoke network architecture and generate Bicep code.
say_en.note: Returns network plan and IaC code.

say_en.text: Design an Azure landing zone for this workload using Terraform.
say_en.note: Generates landing zone topology and Terraform files.

say_en.text: Plan a multi-region DR topology with VNets and firewalls.
